description: Start an app, document or URL without it taking the user's focus. The user may be asked first (an app sidehand has not used yet). Experimental, isolated: start it on a hidden desktop of its own instead, never on the user's screen or taskbar; the other tools reach its windows (list_windows tags them [isolated]; WPF windows capture blank there). Those apps end, unsaved work lost, when this MCP session ends. A single-instance app already running for the user (Edge, Office) hands the request to that instance: then launch fails with 'not isolated'.

app.description: path, App Paths name (notepad, excel), document or URL

isolated.description: start it on sidehand's hidden desktop instead of the user's

name: launch
